resources.string: How SleepFitLearn uses your health data

SleepFitLearn reads these from Health Connect, only after you agree in the app:
• Sleep, exercise and weight — to fill in your daily log. • Steps — to show your daily step total. Only one total per day is saved, not every reading. • Heart rate, resting heart rate and blood pressure — to show your own trends next to the entries you log by hand. For heart rate only a daily summary (lowest, average, highest, resting) is saved, not every reading.
Each reading is saved to your SleepFitLearn account with the name of the app it came from. It is never used for ads or shared with other companies. If you are 13–17 and choose to share personal readings with a linked parent, they can see your latest readings.
You can turn this off and remove access in Health Connect at any time, and delete synced heart rate and blood pressure in the app under Habits → Health Connect.
For wellness only. This is not a medical diagnosis — consult a doctor.
